summary: V4-03 correctly implements social authentication (Google/Apple/Facebook) behind honest ports/adapters, persistent session with direct arrival on Groups after first sign-in, group creation with multiple named members, post-creation member addition, link-only invitations shared via native share sheet, and preserved group options. All V4 Constitution requirements for auth, groups, members, and invitations are met. No demo/email-password in normal UI. E2E secretless session is invisible in normal builds. V2 warm palette (terracotta/cream/sage) is used. i18n FR/EN with correct French accents. All 559 tests pass including privacy, cost, and i18n gates. No regressions of previously accepted V3 invariants.
